philippines.title: At least 64 dead, many more injured in Spain high-speed train collision
philippines.description:
Urda, Spain—A high-speed train collision south of Madrid killed 64 people and injured scores more on Wednesday, with the toll likely to rise, authorities said in one of Europe’s deadliest such disasters this century. AFP reporters on the scene in the central region of Castilla-La Mancha saw one train embedded into another after the second such accident to strike Spain this year. Some carriages were lying on their side in tangles of metal debris at the bottom of an embankment, while dozens of emergency services vehicles were racing to and from the site. philippines.title: NMP invests P261M to upgrade seafarer training facilities in Tacloban
philippines.description:
TACLOBAN CITY, LEYTE, Philippines — Filipino seafarers training in Eastern Visayas are expected to benefit from improved accommodation and upgraded safety training facilities as the National Maritime Polytechnic (NMP) rolls out P261 million worth of infrastructure projects at its Tacloban complex. The projects, unveiled on Tuesday, Oct. 27, form part of the government agency’s modernization efforts to strengthen maritime education and training and help Filipino seafarers meet the changing requirements of the global shipping industry. The NMP broke ground for a P109-million ratings’ dormitory and presented five other projects at its main office and training complex in Barangay Cabalawan. READ: Marcos […]...
